hero.subtitle: FACILITY SERVICE
hero.title: Every service you deliver at a client's site, in one week
hero.body: Cleaning on Monday, the windows every month, the outdoor areas in spring: plan every service for every client on one calendar, run it from the phone and keep the proof.

work.title: Many services, one client, one plan

items.title: Cleaning
items.text: Offices, common areas and institutions on a fixed rhythm.

items.title: Windows
items.text: Rounds every month or every quarter.

items.title: Caretaking
items.text: Rounds and tasks at the client's building.

items.title: Outdoor areas
items.text: Seasonal work, planned with the rest.

sections.title: Each service with its own rhythm, all on one calendar
sections.body: A client can have several recurring tasks, each with its own rule. See the whole week by client or by employee.
sections.illustrationAlt: An illustration of one client with three services, each on its own days of the week

sections.title: The right crew for each service
sections.body: Put a crew on each visit. Each person sees their own visits on the phone and checks in and out on their own.

outcome.text: Each visit has its own crew, each person their own time

sections.title: Proof of every service, for every client
sections.body: Before and after photos and the time on site, on every visit, whatever the service.
sections.illustrationAlt: An illustration of two photos of the same place, before and after

sections.title: Every service, visible to the client
sections.body: Give the client a login and they see their visits for every service, and the photos from each.
sections.illustrationAlt: An illustration of the client portal listing three visits, each with its photos

sections.title: Products for every service, and the next contract
sections.body: Keep products and equipment by storage with low-stock levels, and send proposals as a link you see opened.
sections.illustrationAlt: An illustration of three storages, a van, a cupboard and a room, each with its own boxes

sections.eyebrow: BUILT INSIDE A FACILITY SERVICE COMPANY
sections.title: This is our own industry
sections.body: DFMG is a facility service company. The platform is how we plan, run and prove our own week at our clients' sites.

outcome.text: Used every day in our own facility service company

items.q: Can different people do different services at the same client?
items.a: Yes. Each visit has its own crew.

items.q: Can we see the week by client?
items.a: Yes. The calendar shows every visit by client, by employee and by time.

items.q: Does the client see every service?
items.a: Yes. In the client portal they see their visits for every service, with the photos.

items.title: Cleaning
items.text: Recurring visits, crews and proof of every clean.

items.title: Property service
items.text: Every property a site of its own, every visit on record.

hero.subtitle: FACILITY SERVICE
hero.title: Alle de ydelser, I leverer hos en kunde, i én uge
hero.body: Rengøring om mandagen, vinduerne hver måned, udearealerne om foråret: planlæg hver ydelse for hver kunde i én kalender, kør den fra telefonen, og gem dokumentationen.

work.title: Mange ydelser, én kunde, én plan

items.title: Rengøring
items.text: Kontorer, fællesarealer og institutioner i en fast rytme.

items.title: Vinduer
items.text: Runder hver måned eller hvert kvartal.

items.title: Viceværtopgaver
items.text: Runder og opgaver ved kundens bygning.

sections.title: Hver ydelse med sin egen rytme, alle i én kalender
sections.body: En kunde kan have flere faste opgaver, hver med sin egen regel. Se hele ugen efter kunde eller efter medarbejder.
sections.illustrationAlt: En illustration af én kunde med tre ydelser, hver på sine egne ugedage

sections.title: Det rigtige hold til hver ydelse
sections.body: Sæt et hold på hvert besøg. Hver person ser sine egne besøg på telefonen og checker ind og ud for sig selv.

outcome.text: Hvert besøg har sit eget hold, hver person sin egen tid

sections.title: Dokumentation af hver ydelse, for hver kunde
sections.body: Før- og efterbilleder og tiden på stedet på hvert besøg, uanset ydelsen.
sections.illustrationAlt: En illustration af to billeder af det samme sted, før og efter

sections.title: Hver ydelse synlig for kunden
sections.body: Giv kunden et login, så ser de deres besøg for hver ydelse og billederne fra hvert besøg.
sections.illustrationAlt: En illustration af kundeportalen med tre besøg, hver med sine billeder

sections.title: Produkter til hver ydelse, og den næste aftale
sections.body: Hold produkter og udstyr efter lager med minimumsniveauer, og send tilbud som et link, I kan se er åbnet.
sections.illustrationAlt: En illustration af tre lagre, en varevogn, et skab og et rum, hver med sine egne kasser

sections.title: Det er vores egen branche
sections.body: DFMG er en facility service-virksomhed. Platformen er der, hvor vi planlægger, kører og dokumenterer vores egen uge hos vores kunder.

outcome.text: Brugt hver dag i vores egen facility service-virksomhed

items.q: Kan forskellige personer stå for forskellige ydelser hos samme kunde?
items.a: Ja. Hvert besøg har sit eget hold.

items.q: Kan vi se ugen efter kunde?
items.a: Ja. Kalenderen viser hvert besøg efter kunde, medarbejder og tidspunkt.
Ja. I kundeportalen ser de deres besøg for hver ydelse med billederne.

items.title: Rengøring
items.text: Faste besøg, hold og dokumentation af hver rengøring.

items.title: Ejendomsservice
items.text: Hver ejendom sin egen adresse, hvert besøg registreret.
